legacy_cells.AI: Inter-beat interval (IBI) time series from consumer PPG (Garmin vívosmart 3) and ECG-derived IBI (AMIGOS) in additional training comparisons
legacy_cells.AJ: Four stacked 1D convolutional layers in one stream and a bidirectional LSTM with 32 hidden units in the other; concatenate to a 192-length vector before a dense valence output layer
legacy_cells.BT: Dense regression output for valence, thresholded into high/low valence classes
legacy_cells.DN: Newly collected consumer-PPG IBI dataset and the AMIGOS ECG dataset
legacy_cells.DQ: 17 study participants for the new PPG dataset, and 40 healthy participants in AMIGOS
legacy_cells.FL: IBI time series → parallel 1D convolutional and bidirectional-LSTM temporal feature streams → concatenated 192-length vector → dense valence regression output; Monte Carlo dropout supplies stochastic predictions. No state-transition or planning module is described.
legacy_cells.FM: Applied an existing Bayesian deep-learning emotion classifier to consumer fitness-tracker PPG-derived heartbeat intervals, collected a new dataset, and compared PPG- and ECG-derived IBI properties and training conditions.
legacy_cells.FN: At α = 0.95, peak F1 was 0.7. Adding AMIGOS ECG training data to PPG training produced no significant performance difference (p = 0.16). Training on ECG alone performed no better than chance (chance F1 = 0.57).
legacy_cells.FP: The authors identify future work comparing facial and physiological signals for emotion prediction using the recorded facial video.
legacy_cells.FQ: The authors state that emotion recognition using consumer-fitness-tracker PPG-derived inter-beat intervals had not been explored.
legacy_cells.FR: The evidence is for laboratory-collected emotional-valence classification from 17 participants with internal leave-one-subject-out cross-validation. It does not demonstrate a persistent patient/world state, state-transition rollouts, treatment effects, clinical mental-health outcomes, or prospective clinical utility; the abstract's real-world relevance is an author claim.
legacy_cells.FT: Report the confidence–coverage trade-off alongside predictive performance when using uncertainty thresholds to abstain.
